items.title: Elon Musk issues a warning for 'AI neoclouds' as SpaceX borrows $40 billion for chips

items.title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
items.description: Economics Minister Viktors Valainis says rules could arrive in the first half of next year, but an overdue assessment remains unfinished and no sovereign-bond issuance was identified.

items.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
items.description: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.

items.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends

items.title: Block's new voice AI sounds eerily human, sparking awe and scam fears

items.description: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.

items.title: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker
items.description: Some of the world's biggest companies objected to being listed on the first tokenized securities trading venue under the SEC's innovation exemption. But the early pushback may say more about issuer caution than about rejection of tokenization itself.

items.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
items.description: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

items.title: Hong Kong names Nasdaq-listed Solana Company a strategic enterprise
items.description: The Nasdaq-listed firm said it plans to establish Solana validator operations in Hong Kong.

items.title: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
items.description: A security researcher warned that the leaked shipping details could expose crypto holders to targeted scams and physical attacks.

items.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
items.description: The Standard Chartered and Animoca Brands joint venture previously targeted retail access as early as the end of 2026, but its CEO declined to reaffirm that timeline.

items.title: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
items.description: Similar to the Hugging Face hack, Ethereum researchers have set up an AI Agent message board to help rescue the Glamsterdam fork. ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site successfully hacked.

items.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
items.description: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

items.title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
items.description: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.

items.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
items.description: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

items.title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
items.description: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.

items.title: Brazil's Lula wins historic presidential election; Bolsonaro reportedly refuses to concede
items.description: It's the first time since Brazil returned to direct elections in 1989 that a candidate has won the final runoff after losing in the first round.

items.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal for AI chips, Elon Musk says
items.description: Elon Musk said in an X post that SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt financing to purchase GPUs.

items.title: ‘Ticking time bomb’: The world's pension funds face an ageing crisis
items.description: The world's pension systems are confronting a demographic crisis as longer lifespans and dwindling birth rates threaten to stretch retirement finances.

items.title: Blanche defends Trump-ordered lawsuit over Alaska Senate election certification
items.description: Democrats have maintained they have no connection to Daniel J. Sullivan.

items.title: Ukraine disputes Elon Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms during drone operations
items.description: Ukraine challenged Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms, arguing that commercial Starlink limits prevented medium- and long-range strike use.

items.title: Audi defends plans for a $4 billion Georgia plant amid VW restructuring, tariffs
items.description: Audi's CEO defended the company's plans for a $4 billion plant in Georgia, calling it a business decision to grow sales and reduce exposure to U.S. tariffs.

items.title: Behind ‘Mad Money’ was a brilliant writer viewers never saw. We lost him too soon

items.title: America by the numbers: How voters feel about the economy, inflation, AI and Trump
